contract: Locator passes strict:true and options to frame.click; frame maps noWaitAfter to waitAfter=false. Pre-action visible/enabled/stable and hit-target checks remain. Input action is awaited. Navigation signal barrier/epilogue and post-action hit-interceptor-result wait are not awaited with this option; interceptor cleanup remains. No force or dispatchEvent option is introduced.
proposedDelta: Only Skip introduction: skip.click({ timeout: 1500, noWaitAfter: true }). Existing stop and same-scene/original-actor readiness checks determine completion; generic click errors still propagate, no physical retry.
